title: Unpaid-Month Schedule for Pre-K Tuition Late Fees
content:
**Schedule.** On a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a late fee carries an addition that depends on how much of the late month's tuition charge is still unpaid on the day the fee is assessed.

The part of the month's tuition still unpaid is the lesser of that month's tuition charge and the open balance, never less than zero. The open balance is the enrollment's tuition charges, late fees and refunds less its payments and credits, payments reaching the oldest open charge first.

| Part of the month's tuition charge still unpaid | Addition to the late fee |
|---|---|
| the whole charge | 15.00 |
| at least half of the charge, but not all of it | 5.00 |
| less than half of the charge | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical month with a tuition charge of 400.00)

| Open balance on the day of assessment | Part still unpaid | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| 650.00 | 400.00, the whole charge (the lesser of 400.00 and 650.00) | 15.00 |
| 400.00 | 400.00, the whole charge | 15.00 |
| 399.99 | 399.99, at least half but not all | 5.00 |
| 200.00 | 200.00, exactly half | 5.00 |
| 199.99 | 199.99, less than half | nothing |
